meta.title: Should order events move to a managed queue?
meta.description: Decision page for the platform team.

conclusion: Yes. Move order events to the managed queue this quarter: it removes our largest on-call burden and costs less than the engineer time we spend on the self-hosted broker.

items.label: On-call load
items.detail: 7 of the last 12 pages were broker disk or rebalance issues.

items.label: Cost
items.detail: Managed pricing is about $1.9k/month against roughly 0.4 engineer of upkeep.

items.label: Delivery guarantees
items.detail: Built-in dead-letter queues replace our custom retry table.

panels.title: Main risk
panels.body: Message ordering is per partition key only. Consumers that assume global order must be fixed before cut-over.

items.label: Dual-publish
items.detail: Write to both brokers for two weeks.

items.label: Move consumers
items.detail: One service at a time, behind a flag.
